scope: Independent substantive source assessment only; no paper review, scientific imports, numerical arrays, parity grids, server/GPU work or source edits.
verdict: No substantive core equation/control/gradient/parameter-ownership defect identified. Optimizer, selector, RNG manager, export and CAL are caller interfaces, so this is not execution qualification.

confirmed.finding: P1 retains source mean/skip transforms on the same dropped sparse values or dense hidden input, p=.4, row z/max(norm,1) in both layers, first-only ReLU, Glorot aggregate/skip and zero bias, and .05 first-layer matrix squares. The factor/feedback RNGs do not consume slow Glorot draws.

The helper constructs D=diag(max(rowcounts,1))^-1 B and C=diag(max(columncounts,1))^-1 B^T from positive undropped raw-X entries. Empty incidence rows give zero output; the forward inserts C/phi/D after the first clipped ReLU and before native second-layer dropout.

SA4 uses its own hub; SM4 maps the mean of the three other hubs; SX4 averages the three other already mapped donors. Both peer controls exclude n=m and use four calls to the same shared phi, with equal rank16/scale.25/site/parameter count. UX4 applies each donor's private phi before exclusion/averaging.

No detach/no_grad/cache removes donor credit in the core. Vmap=0 makes feedback zero, dloss/dBmap=0, and the feedback-only donor-to-recipient first-layer derivative zero initially; Vmap may receive a nonzero first gradient. Own recipient-layer gradients remain. After Vmap changes, cross paths can carry credit, without a guarantee every gradient becomes nonzero.

The penalty is .05 sum(r_i^2 W_ij^2 s_j^2) for first-layer aggregate and skip only. Joint models average route penalties once; each returned I4/IA4 M1 has a full own penalty. Feedback maps and second-layer parameters are unpenalized as declared. Factorization changes optimization despite the source marginal Glorot law for each route's effective matrix; F1/I4 remain substantive controls.

I4/IA4 return four separate M1 Models; UX4 returns one Model containing four fresh Bodies and four private feedback map pairs. The inspector checks cross-owner Parameter/storage aliases, including UX4 feedback-versus-body and feedback-versus-feedback aliases. Declared counts agree with layer/factor/bias/map algebra.

bounded_caller_risks.risk: The factory is not the original MeanSAGE class ABI: logits are [1,N,5], bias has a leading route dimension, and state-dict names differ. Source semantics require the bound TF1Adam (epsilon before bias correction and saved float32 beta powers), total own CE+L2, latest tied SELECT minimum, 50 strictly worse updates and 100000 ceiling. These are not implemented by core.py. Ordinary Torch Adam/AdamW or accuracy-based selection would change the learner.

Forward checks C/D shapes only; the helper assumes qualified coalesced binary raw X. The controller must construct and bind one fixed C/D pair before dropout and reuse it across every equipped control, rather than deriving per-route or per-update incidence from dropped X. Sparse/autograd/runtime behavior is outside this source audit.

A first-update qualification must accept zero Bmap and feedback-donor gradients at Vmap=0. SX4/SM4 can still have different Vmap gradients because ReLU is applied before versus after donor averaging. Keep a complete joint live forward/backward before the single update; detached-prefix or separately updated donor shortcuts would change the method. Do not add a gradient nonzero gate or numerical grid.

The factory forks/restores CPU construction RNG and stores a plain post_constructor_cpu_rng attribute; it does not create CUDA/dropout streams or checkpoint mutable route state. Bind persistent route/body CPU/CUDA streams prospectively and restore them fully; cloning the same stream into all routes does not establish independent masks. Each independent M1 calls its context with local route0, so I4/IA4 must bind that call to the actual body, not a shared route0 manager.

The inspector validates parameters, not optimizers or selectors. I4/IA4 need four exact own parameter sets, full unscaled own CE+L2 and four own selector/stopping/checkpoint states. UX4 needs one optimizer over every disjoint body+feedback group, one mean own CE plus one averaged effective penalty and one synchronized joint selector/checkpoint; it is a coupled learner. Do not divide model.regularizer() by four again.

The core returns clipped raw logits and implements no pool/CAL. Raw authority is mean_m softmax(z_m), with archived native member/pool argmax. CAL must use mean_m softmax(member_logprob_m/T), a common scalar inside each member, Adam lr.05 for500 steps, clamp logT[-5,5], latest tied minimum among step0..500. This equals softmax(z_m/T) per member up to class-common shifts, and generally differs from softmax(mean_m z_m/T). Calibrated bank argmax may change; report raw and calibrated accuracy with raw primary. The sign-dropout post-raw-mean/final500 reader is incompatible.

repair_disposition: No sealed core repair requested from this source audit. The method owner should preserve the explicit caller contracts in its controller/reader; root retains the required finite full-input execution check. No additional qualification requested.
